title: M5Stack Atom Lite
summary: A compact board with three distinct installation roles.
body:
## Choose the role first

For Room presence, power the board from a plain 5 V USB supply and configure the ESPHome BLE proxy. Position proxies where Bluetooth coverage is needed. The optional radar has its own [wiring guide](/devices/hlk-ld2410c/).

For awnings, a separate board runs ESPSomfy-RTS firmware with a [CC1101 radio](/devices/cc1101/). It is not simultaneously the ESPHome Bluetooth proxy.

For a gate remote, a board runs the gate-remote component's firmware, first to capture the handset and then to send its code, with an [M5Stack CC1101 module](/devices/m5stack-module-cc1101/) for 868 MHz handsets. The module takes 5 V from the Atom's 5V socket.

## Verify before use

Confirm the selected firmware, network connection and Home Assistant integration before mapping component inputs. Keep Wi-Fi credentials and API encryption keys in your private home project.

## Setup references

- [Bluetooth proxy — ESPHome](https://esphome.io/components/bluetooth_proxy/)

These upstream instructions may evolve; the component versions and pinned source above record the DomoSenso scope.
